status: Design contract and data, not an executable transpiler. Bindings describe what to verify; no entry installs, activates or grants anything.

status_vocabulary.supported: The target has an equivalent whose semantics were checked against the invariants.
status_vocabulary.emulated: Achievable with a described loss of guarantee; see guarantee_lost_if_emulated.
status_vocabulary.manual: A human or coordinator performs it; not automatically complete.
status_vocabulary.unsupported: No equivalent; the dependent action is blocked if blocks_if_missing names one.
status_vocabulary.unknown: Not yet verified. Not the same as unsupported. Requires a todo.

primitives.summary: A durable behavioral contract for one function: purpose, decision lens, boundaries, anti-jobs.
invariants: Instructions are loaded explicitly, not assumed from a filename.
Boundaries and anti-jobs are visible to the agent every run.
An independent seat has its own context, not a relabelled copy of the implementer.
primitives.guarantee_lost_if_emulated: Independence collapses into one context; self-review cannot satisfy a required independent seat.

grok.notes: Verify the saved profile text and effective capabilities; a profile is not a permission grant.

primitives.summary: An addressed, asynchronous message from one agent to another, with a priority flag and visible sender.
invariants: Delivery is addressed and asynchronous; no live back-and-forth is assumed.
Priority is a flag the sender sets, reserved for scores, one-way-door bounces and real decisions.
A message transfers information, never authorization.
primitives.guarantee_lost_if_emulated: Without a priority channel the coordinator is not woken at claims-done; fall back to polling the shared record and accept delay.

primitives.summary: A saved intent plus a trigger (clock, repository event, chat event or webhook) and a named destination.
invariants: Trigger, reads, outputs, destination, deduplication key and terminal behavior are explicit.
Silent when nothing changed; a failed source is reported, never "nothing moved".
A PR-scoped routine deletes itself on merge or close.
Prompts state intent, not frozen tool arguments.
primitives.guarantee_lost_if_emulated: Event delivery degrades to polling; a watcher cannot be self-deleting, so stale watchers must be cleaned up manually.
primitives.blocks_if_missing: merge-on-green watching, twice-daily wake, alarm response

primitives.summary: An integration or command-line tool with an explicit permission scope.
invariants: Effective capabilities are inspected, not assumed from prompt promises.
Read-only means read-only.
Least privilege; no credentials in the public package.
The acting identity is known and attributable per agent, or the ledger records which seat acted.
Recommended target: a distinct per-agent identity with least-privilege scopes (for example an app identity or machine user per agent); shared login is the low-friction default.
primitives.guarantee_lost_if_emulated: An action silently runs with broader or narrower authority than claimed. With a shared login, platform attribution is lost and cannot separate agents or the human.

grok.mechanism: MCP connectors and CLIs the bot is granted; inspect effective capabilities.
grok.notes: Default: one shared platform login for merges and other code-host actions, because it is low friction. Tradeoff: attribution is lost, so ledgers record the seat that acted. Recommended target: a distinct identity per bot (for example a GitHub App or machine user) with least-privilege scopes. Inspect effective capabilities.
grok.evidence: observed in the source fleet, 2026-11-17; not independently verified here
